name: Radiant
title: Serra's Archangel
role: Angelic guardian of Serra's artificial plane
summary: The guardian whose increasingly severe rule preceded the collapse of Serra's Realm and the creation of the Weatherlight's power source.
biography: Serra entrusted her realm to Radiant when Phyrexian corruption drove its creator away.
Radiant's determination to eliminate infiltration hardened into suspicion of her own people, while the realm without Serra continued to deteriorate.
The Weatherlight helped rescue inhabitants before the plane collapsed. Its mana and Radiant's divine light became part of the powerstone fueling the skyship.

Radiant had been created among Serra's earliest archangels and was entrusted with a sanctuary defined by its creator's ideals. Her authority therefore carried an unusually personal burden: to protect not just a population but an environment that expressed Serra's vision of refuge and ordered peace.

As Phyrexian agents exploited the realm's fears, Radiant's determination hardened into suspicion. The throne she inherited was not meant for her and inflicted suffering; that detail helps explain the deterioration of her judgment without excusing the harm that followed. Fear of corruption became a means by which the realm harmed itself.

The Weatherlight evacuation and the collapse of Serra's Realm ended Radiant's rule, but her light contributed to the vessel's later power. Her legacy is consequently tragic and double-sided: a failed guardian of one world became part of a machine used to defend another.

featuredCard.significance: The original Urza's Legacy depiction of the archangel who guarded Serra's failing realm.
